title: [Minor bug] Can't close some doors if own/access them

posts.author: Alexander
posts.title: [Minor bug] Can't close some doors if own/access them
posts.html:
Some doors, such as the 2 KFC doors, and the BP Connect doors (if I remember correctly) can not be closed if you own them or are on the access list. (By closing them I mean keeping them in the middle)

If you own them or are on the access list then the door will "jump past the close part" and just continue to the other side, if you understand what I mean.
Other people, that are not on the access list and do not own the door can close the door correctly.

It is the best I can explain at this moment, if you do not understand what I mean feel free to reply and I shall try to explain it in more detail.
